children: Geospace Technologies' revenue fell 27.1% and its net loss widened year over year, primarily as demand declined for Hydroconn cables and connectors and for ocean bottom nodes and marine recovery devices. The decline was partially offset by $11.9M in revenue recognized on the ongoing PRM contract.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Revenue fell 51.9%, primarily due to lower demand for Hydroconn cable and connector products.
: Revenue declined 19.3%; the ongoing PRM contract contributed $11.9M, while lower ocean bottom node and traditional seismic product demand weighed on sales.
: Revenue declined 7.1% as industrial sensor demand decreased, partially offset by higher security and defense revenue.
: Fiscal 2027 Energy Solutions revenue is expected to increase significantly, with most of the PRM contract expected to be completed in the third quarter.
